svg.aria-label: Installing mnem0nic and importing claude-mem history in the terminal

g.font-family: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
g.text: Claude Code: capture hooks in /Users/you/.claude/settings.json (backup: …), and the mnem0nic MCP server
Codex: capture hooks in /Users/you/.codex/hooks.json (backup: …), and the mnem0nic MCP server added for all
Codex asks you to trust the new hooks once, at its next start.
claude-mem's history is on this machine: /Users/you/.claude-mem/claude-mem.db

text.tspan: Import it into mnem0nic now? It is only read, and you can import again later. [Y/n]

g.text: Imported 1284 observations, 312 session summaries, 940 prompts, 2113 tool calls and 18 to-do entries, in 7
Then turn claude-mem off, so notes aren't taken twice: npx claude-mem uninstall (its data is kept).
Done. Restart Claude Code or Codex to start capturing.
